title: E-NVG-0013: the admissible-address count (no two adjacent ones) follows the Fibonacci recurrence and grows by the...
purpose: Experiment E-NVG-0013 in the addressing arena: the admissible-address count (no two adjacent ones) follows the Fibonacci recurrence and grows by the golden ratio (1 + sqrt 5)/2, so the five enters the addressing through the square root of five in the golden mean, while plain binary grows by two.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
